added.summary: `og api show components --guide` lists every built-in component, control and screen that @origingame/engine/ui/components exports, one section each: what it draws, its props with their types and docs (from its `<Name>Props` interface), the row types those props name, the pack slots it dresses, whether it is a piece of a panel, its fixtures and the input actions it answers. `og api gen` writes it from the components' own source and `og api check` fails on any difference, so it cannot drift; `og api find` ranks its sections (`og api find health bar` answers with the components that draw one), and the `ui` module points at it. It replaces the CSS-era catalogue removed with og-ui.
